Toll Facility Market Lead
As part of HDR’s Highways and Roads market sector, the toll facility market lead will be responsible to support our local areas with the identification and development of projects and programs where HDR can bring our suite of professional services to toll facility clients. Toll facility clients include agencies and authorities that own, operate and maintain roads, bridges and tunnels that charge fees to users that travel on their facilities.
Toll facilities will be a sub-sector to HDR’s highways and roads market sector within the transportation business group. Services that the toll facility market lead will look to bring to these clients include:

  • Planning and Design services including, roadway, bridges, tunnels, transport hydraulics and geotechnical
  • Mobility and operational technology services including ATST, ITS, CAV, tolling system development and operations, managed lanes, ZEM and OT cybersecurity
  • Advisory services including asset management, ROW, value engineering, funding and finance
  • Building and facility design
The toll facility market lead will be responsible for the growth and success of tolling services and programs for toll road clients and will be expected to work with area business development leaders and business group managers to:
  • Develop and share knowledge of trends and drivers within the toll market
  • Support areas in the identification, pursuit and delivery of area toll facility client opportunities where HDR can compete and deliver professional services
  • Support areas in the research of toll facility clients in their markets and help develop client relationships that include local area teams and market sector teams
  • Support TBG region directors in the evaluation and prioritization of toll facility client investments and opportunities across their regions and the business group as the program expands
The toll facility market lead will be an individual with established relationships with toll facility agencies and authorities and someone with a reputation of leading programs in the highway/roads market.
This role will be expected to work with HDR leaders across the business group to broaden the range of toll services offered by HDR and to provide professional development for staff as they provide services to toll facility clients.
The toll facility market lead will be expected to support local area and business group leaders in the identification and participation of industry organizations that will contribute to the growth of HDR with toll facility clients and within the highway and roads market sector.
The toll facility market lead will lead HDR’s strategy for presence and leadership in industry organizations including IBTTA and others.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker role at Canonical

2 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker role at Canonical

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: This role can be based in Americas and the assigned territory will be Chile. Being based in Chile is therefore preferable.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as Spanish for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

IT Functional Analyst - Information Security IAM (Hybrid work)

Highlights of this position:

  • Mandatory: English Fluency, Identity Access Management previous experience, Cucumber or similar, Agile methodology

Who we are?

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company with 61,000+ employees, approximately 1000 laboratories across 61 countries, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

The Team

Eurofins endeavours to develop all of our software applications in-house to service and support our numerous laboratories globally. With hundreds of thousands of clinical diagnostic tests performed every day, the laboratories of the Eurofins clinical diagnostic services business line strive to ensure that every patient, wherever he or she lives, has access to the most specialized and most innovative techniques for diagnosis, monitoring and therapeutic decisions. Such activities require extensive planning and organisation which can be augmented by the use of technology.

Our Clinical LIMS Europe Program will extensively be used as the central Laboratory Information Management System throughout Europe, this role is crucial in defining and delivering the product roadmap.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owner to define and document the requirements for building an access rights management application suitable for the organisation.
  • Understand business needs and translate the high-level business requirements into detailed functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Create business process workflows and system designs as per the collected requirements.
  • Develop the requirements into user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria to be used by Scrum team for development.
  • Work closely with Product Owner, Scrum team to develop the solution using Agile methodology.
  • Use Cucumber or similar tool to document and verify application functionality implementing Behavior Driven Development (BDD) methodology.
  • Assist in defining test cases and validating developed functionalities to ensure alignment with the approved requirements.
  • Ensure the documentation of the developed application is written and accurate.
  • Conduct UAT testing to validate implementation of the requirements.
  • Analyse existing access control processes and recommend improvements for efficiency.
  • Ensure the solution adheres to IAM policies, procedures, and documentation.
  • Provide functional expertise in IAM tools and platforms, ensuring optimal configuration and performance.
  • Collaborate with Operations team to troubleshoot access management related issues as needed.
  • Conduct meetings, training sessions, and workshops for key users to ensure smooth adoption of systems.
  • Participate in requirement elicitation and understanding of other solutions within Identity and Access domain.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in IAM.

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to grow in a demanding, fast-growing organization.
  • Very attractive, multicultural, and friendly work environment in fast-growing international company (more than 60,000 employees now)
  • Possibility to grow and take the next step in your professional career and self-development.
  • A launch pad into various opportunities – within many business lines of Eurofins globally.
  • A chance to become part of a highly motivated international team of professionals.
  • BE/ B.Tech /MCA or any other equivalent degree.
  • Proficiency in English is a must
  • 3-7 years of experience as a Business/ Functional Analyst.
  • Experience in UML, Visio, Draw.io to create domain model, activity diagrams to clarify requirements.
  • Experience with functional designs and tools for user journeys.
  • Experience with agile development and management platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar.
  • Experience in User Training and delivering Application Demonstrations.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to produce clear documentation and written materials.
  • Experience working with cross functional teams.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills across various business functions, including management, multinational teams within organization, external partners, and business customers.
  • Ability to engage in constructive discussions, challenge stakeholders, and drive towards optimal solutions.
  • Strong critical thinking abilities with the capacity to question and analyse requests in alignment with regulatory requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Eagerness to learn and develop both personally and technically.
  • Detail-oriented with strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Have strong communication, presentation skills, and the ability to engage in productive discussions to ensure successful solution delivery.

Working hours:

Monday to Friday - 8:00 to 17:00 Hybrid Work

Additional Information

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.7 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

As a proud division of Live Nation Entertainment, Ticketmaster has changed the way the world connects with their favourite artists, teams, and shows, and we continue to shape innovation every day. We're not just selling tickets (though we do that better than anyone else!), we’re enriching lives, one amazing experience at a time. And we think that’s incredible. If you’re passionate about the magic of live entertainment like we are, and you want to work for a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want you on our team.


THE JOB

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack .NET Developer to join our team and collaborate on the development of a financial settlement solution for the ticketing industry. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust, secure, and scalable applications, ensuring the efficiency and reliability of payment settlement processes.

This role is critical to building an innovative system that will optimize the financial flow among event organizers, customers, and payment platforms. If you’re looking for technical challenges and the opportunity to make a direct impact in a dynamic, global sector, this is the position for you!

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Develop and implement software solutions using .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core) for web applications and APIs.
  • Design and maintain robust, scalable backend systems, ensuring high performance, security, and reliability in financial transaction processing.
  • Create dynamic and responsive user interfaces using modern front-end technologies such as JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Work with SQL Server databases, including modeling, creating and maintaining complex queries, performance optimization, stored procedures, and triggers.
  • Implement unit and integration tests, ensuring code quality and system stability.
  • Apply agile development practices (Scrum, Kanban) for planning, analyzing, designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining solutions.
  • Ensure system security and compliance with regulatory standards and industry best practices for payments.
  • Collaborate with other technical and business teams to align requirements and continuously enhance the platform.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core).
  • Solid knowledge of SQL Server, including data modeling, query optimization, stored procedures, and triggers.
  • Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js).
  • Familiarity with Git version control and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with tools like Jira or Trello.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work in a dynamic, high-impact environment.
  • Experience with payment API integrations or financial systems is a plus.
  • Knowledge of security practices and regulatory compliance in financial systems is a plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Spanish is preferred.

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Initiative and Ownership: Proactively identifies opportunities for improvement and takes full ownership of projects from conception to completion.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Uses critical thinking to overcome obstacles and find innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Continuous Learning: Actively seeks to enhance skills and stay updated on industry trends, sharing knowledge with the team.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team.

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent.

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and home life. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

About JumpCloud

JumpCloud delivers a unified open directory platform that makes it easy to securely manage identities, devices, and access across your organization. With JumpCloud, IT teams and MSPs enable users to work securely from anywhere and manage their Windows, Apple, Linux, and Android devices from a single platform. JumpCloud is IT Simplified.

About the Role

The Senior Data Engineer will have a crucial role on the Enterprise Data and Analytics (EDA) team, an internal, cross-functional analytics team that supports stakeholders across all company’s business units, including Finance, Marketing, Sales, Growth, UX, Customer Success, and Product. The primary responsibility of this role is to drive JumpCloud’s core reporting by developing data pipelines, curating and modeling data, and designing databases to enable insights and self-service across the analytics team and organization.

The Senior Data Engineer will collaborate with analytics teams (EDA, embedded analysts), technical teams (Enterprise Support Systems, Platform Engineering, Software Engineering), and business stakeholders to develop and maintain data pipelines, curated data models, and database designs that will support business and analytics insights throughout the organization.

The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about data and continuous improvement. They will have the ability to balance and prioritize multiple projects, ask insightful questions in an ambiguous environment, and coordinate execution across various stakeholders. A proactive and hands-on approach is essential, as JumpCloud is a lean and fast-moving company.


What you’ll be doing:
  • Driving large, impactful projects involving data pipelines, database design, data modeling, and data curation for optimized analytics and business use with involvement across various stakeholders, business units, and technical partners.
  • Owning the outcomes of the analytics initiatives you’re leading. You’re not just a participant in the initiative, you hold yourself responsible for the outcome of the project.
  • Gathering requirements and providing actionable recommendations to technical stakeholders, driving adoption and execution of recommendations.
  • Mentoring and growing the other analysts and engineers across the organization. We’ve got a great organization full of a lot of potential, you’ll be helping the other members of the organization achieve their potential.
  • Supporting team's project management, strategic decision-making, and long-term planning.
  • Staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data engineering, database design, data modeling, and data governance and applying them to support our business needs.
We’re looking for:
  • Advanced knowledge and experience in SQL and relational databases; Snowflake experience highly preferred.
  • Advanced knowledge in database design, data modeling, data infrastructure, data pipelines, and ELT process to support analytics and business operations. DBT, Airflow, Fivetran, AWS, and GitHub experiences are highly preferred.
  • Advanced understanding of coding and markup languages and can create complex queries from multiple data sources, views, and tables and have an understanding of our company's data architecture and how to apply it.
  • Advanced understanding and experience with scripting languages such as Python (numpy, pandas).
  • Intermediate analytical skills and a passion for data storytelling and quantitative analysis.
  • Understanding in one or more business Intelligence / data visualization tools; Tableau experience highly preferred.
  • Strong mentoring skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and desire to learn.
  • Effective stakeholder management skills and communication skills.
  • Effective project management and organizational skills; Agile experience is a plus.
  • Experience with Data Governance best practices.
  • Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, unstructured, dynamic environment.
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems, or another quantitative field.

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. Responsabilidades e atribuições

Mídia performance

  • Gestão do budget de mídia digital e sua alocação estratégica entre parceiros e canais;

Branding e Comunicação
  • Ser guardião da marca, garantindo consistência e posicionamento em todos os pontos de contato;
  • Gestão das redes sociais da marca, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia de comunicação;
  • Desenvolvimento de campanhas em parceria com a agência criativa.

Em ambas as áreas:
  • Gestão de equipe multidisciplinar, com foco em growth e performance;
  • Relacionamento com os parceiros e as agências de performance, comunicação e PR;
  • Atuação estratégica junto ao time internacional, bem como com as equipes internas (Programação, A&B, Operações, Loyalty & CRM, Tecnologia).

Requisitos e qualificações
Requisitos:
  • Graduação em Marketing, Publicidade, Administração de Empresas, Engenharias e áreas afins;

  • Vivência com ferramentas de web analytics (GA4, GTM, MMP, etc);

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Marketing at TRACTIAN:

The Marketing team crafts the narrative, defines messaging and positioning, and translates our groundbreaking products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our cross-functional team, spanning Product Marketing, Customer Experience, Growth, Branding, and Events, is dedicated to acquiring new customers and deeply understanding our business. We collaborate closely with various teams to help our clients reach their full potential.

What you'll do:

As our Content Manager, you’ll drive our regional content strategy from planning to execution. This includes managing our editorial calendar, optimizing performance across channels, and aligning with business goals. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Growth, and Sales to create impactful content supporting inbound acquisition, ABM campaigns, and customer education.

This role combines editorial excellence, technical affinity, and a performance mindset, making it ideal for a hands-on and strategic professional.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the content calendar for Brazil across blogs, landing pages, partner media, newsletters, and outbound campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain a pipeline of high-performing content assets supporting awareness, education, and conversion.
  • Lead localization and adaptation of content created by US and MX teams, ensuring cultural and technical relevance.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing and Sales to produce BOFU assets like comparison pages, case studies, and playbooks.
  • Support ABM and demand generation with tailored content for target accounts.
  • Track and analyze content performance metrics for future optimization.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders and external partners to scale output without quality loss.
  • Partner with SEO team to ensure content supports growth strategies and keyword opportunities.

Requirements

  • 5+ years managing B2B content, preferably in SaaS or industrial tech.
  • Proven ability to lead editorial planning and coordinate workflows across teams.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, especially in simplifying technical topics.
  • Experience with SEO tools (e.g., Semrush, Ahrefs) and CMS platforms.
  • Data-driven mindset with experience measuring content impact on traffic, leads, and pipeline.
  • Highly autonomous, organized, and deadline-oriented.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Compensation:

  • Competitive salary and stock options.
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses.
  • 30 days of paid annual leave.
  • Education and courses stipend.
  • Employee Giving program.
  • Opportunity to earn a trip worldwide every 4 years.
  • Up to R$1,000/month for meals and remote work allowance.
  • Health plan with national coverage without coparticipation.
  • Dental insurance for improved quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/month extra for activities.

Additional Information

Na MCS Markup, o trabalho é mais do que cumprir tarefas; é uma jornada de crescimento e aprendizado constante. Se você deseja fazer parte de um time que valoriza seu desenvolvimento, que enxerga além dos números e busca impactar positivamente a vida das pessoas, então seu lugar é aqui.
Junte-se a nós e faça parte do time MCS Markup, onde as oportunidades se entrelaçam com a paixão por um trabalho bem-feito. Sua carreira está esperando por você - venha fazer história conosco!
Na MCS Markup todas as oportunidades são aderentes à diversidade e abertas a pessoas com deficiência! Valorizamos a singularidade de cada indivíduo e acreditamos que a inclusão enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho.
Se você busca um espaço onde suas habilidades e potencial sejam reconhecidos, esta é a sua chance! Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que preza pela diversidade e pela igualdade.
Sobre a vaga:
Buscamos Consultor (a) de Due Diligence Sênior, para atuar em nosso time no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou Remoto para demais localidades.
Requisitos e qualificações:
O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Graduação concluída em Ciências Contábeis ou Administração;
  • Conhecimento no pacote office, com ênfase em Excel Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Inglês Avançado;

Sendo diferencial, vivencia anterior em big4 e/ou consultoria.

  • Atuar em projetos de Due Diligence contábil/financeira relacionados a potenciais transações de compra e/ou venda de empresas;
  • Analisar demonstrações financeiras, indicadores operacionais e dados contábeis com foco em entender a performance histórica, qualidade dos resultados (EBITDA ajustado), capital de giro, endividamento, entre outros;
  • Conduzir reuniões com clientes, investidores e empresas-alvo para levantamento de informações e esclarecimento de dúvidas;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time técnico, delegando tarefas de forma eficaz e gerenciando a equipe nos projetos;
  • Revisar os trabalhos técnicos realizados pela equipe, reportando os principais pontos ao gerente e ao sócio responsável;
  • Identificar oportunidades e auxiliar na elaboração de propostas e no desenvolvimento de novos negócios.
O que oferecemos:
  • Contratação CLT;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);

  • Plataforma de Gestão de Saúde Emocional;
  • Day off no seu aniversário;
  • Universidade Corporativa;
Etapas do processo:
Inscrição: Inicie sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro. Fique tranquilo(a), nossa equipe irá analisar as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Entrevista com Recursos Humanos: Você terá a oportunidade de dialogar com nosso time de Atração de Talentos;
Seleção. O objetivo é nos conhecermos melhor e garantir que nossos valores e abordagens estejam alinhados com suas crenças e expectativas.
Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta fase, mergulharemos no seu conhecimento técnico para avaliar as habilidades e competências essenciais para a posição.
Retorno do processo: Independentemente do resultado, iremos comunicá-lo a você e discutir os próximos passos.

A Nossa Volkswagen quer ser a cada dia mais diversa, digital, ágil, centrada no cliente e neutra em carbono. O nosso compromisso é em entregar cada vez mais valor aos nossos clientes, colaboradores, parceiros e para a sociedade. Esperamos oferecer experiências incríveis e construir o futuro de uma maneira mais sustentável e surpreendente.

Incentivamos o debate, as novas ideias e soluções. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a empatia, e juntos, aceleramos!

Somos a única montadora a receber em todos os anos, desde 2019, a certificação Top Employer, o mais importante reconhecimento internacional da excelência de uma empresa na gestão de pessoas.

“Acreditamos na potência das nossas pessoas, afinal, são elas que fazem a diferença dia após dia! Trabalhamos para que todos os times estejam integrados, em constante desenvolvimento. Buscamos talentos que sejam movidos por desafios e que façam parte da transformação cultural da Nossa Volkswagen: mais humana, diversa e inclusiva!”, diz Douglas Pereira, Vice-Presidente de Recursos Humanos.

Construa com a gente a Nossa Volkswagen !

Volkswagen tem compromisso com agenda ESG

Em 2020, a Volkswagen do Brasil aderiu aos Princípios de Empoderamento das Mulheres (Womens’s Empowerment Principles - WEPs, na sigla em inglês), iniciativa criada pela ONU Mulheres e o Pacto Global das Nações Unidas. Dessa forma, a VW se une a mais de 300 empresas signatárias no Brasil.

Em 2022, a Volkswagen anunciou a emissão de títulos de dívida de 500 milhões de reais, atrelados a compromissos claros da montadora de aumentar a participação de mulheres na liderança e a redução nas emissões de CO2 de origem fóssil em suas fábricas.

Com essas medidas, a VW firma ainda mais o seu compromisso em promover a igualdade de gênero na companhia, e em neutralizar emissões de carbono.

title: Product Owner
description:
Job description

Na Supercomm , somos mais do que uma empresa de tecnologia; somos arquitetos de soluções que simplificam o mundo e impulsionam o futuro. Fundada em 2012 , nossa jornada é marcada por uma paixão inabalável por inovar e entregar valor, combinando Venda Consultiva , um forte Canal Digital e Eficiência Operacional em cada passo que damos.

Somos uma empresa com uma visão ousada. Este é o resultado de uma expansão estratégica para cinco categorias de negócio – de Impressão & Suprimentos a Telecomunicações, Serviços, Telecomunicações Enterprise e até um Banco Digital – demonstrando nossa adaptabilidade e ambição.

Nossos valores são o coração da Supercomm: Respeito ao indivíduo em primeiro lugar, a Velocidade para nos movermos rápido e aprendermos com os erros, a Valorização que gera valor para todos os envolvidos, e o Crescimento que nos desafia a inovar e a nos desenvolver constantemente. Se você busca um lugar para crescer, inovar e ser valorizado, venha construir o futuro da tecnologia conosco!

Sobre a Posição: Seu Impacto como PO na Supercomm

Buscamos uma pessoa Product Owner que será a força motriz por trás da entrega de soluções inovadoras e de alto impacto na Supercomm. Você terá a responsabilidade de liderar projetos complexos, desde a concepção até a implementação, garantindo que nossas iniciativas de tecnologia se traduzam em resultados concretos, alinhados à nossa visão de futuro e à nossa busca incessante por Eficiência Operacional e Atitude Digital .

Sua capacidade de transformar ideias em planos acionáveis, gerenciar equipes multidisciplinares e navegar por desafios com Resolução de Problemas será crucial para o nosso sucesso. Se você tem Espírito Empreendedor e adora ver um projeto sair do papel e gerar valor, este é o seu lugar!


Main responsibilities

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Definição Estratégica : Liderar a análise e aprofundamento de requisitos, definindo o contexto e o "guard rail" (diretrizes estratégicas) para novos produtos e projetos, com um foco especial em soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial aplicadas em atendimento com linguagem natural.
  • Gestão de Projetos : Conduzir o ciclo de vida completo dos projetos, desde a concepção e validação de ideias até o planejamento detalhado e a implementação, garantindo a entrega de valor contínuo.
  • Visão de Mercado e Tecnologia : Realizar a prospecção e avaliação de possíveis fornecedores de tecnologia e soluções, ou orquestrar o desenvolvimento interno, sempre visando a melhor abordagem para as necessidades da Supercomm.
  • Interface Estratégica: Atuar como um elo vital entre o C-level e as equipes técnicas, traduzindo a visão executiva em planos acionáveis e garantindo a comunicação fluida entre todas as partes interessadas.
  • Análise de Dados : Utilizar dados, incluindo informações do DataLake, para embasar decisões estratégicas, otimizar produtos e identificar novas oportunidades de inovação.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e Qualificações: Quem nós procuramos?

  • Graduação completa em áreas como Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de produtos, análise de negócios, gestão de projetos estratégicos ou consultoria em tecnologia.
  • Comprovada capacidade de interagir e influenciar stakeholders de alto nível, com excelente comunicação e habilidades de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Habilidade para transformar ideias de alto nível em requisitos detalhados e planos de ação concretos.
  • Familiaridade com o uso estratégico de dados e plataformas como Data Lakes para tomada de decisão.
  • Demonstra interesse e/ou experiência prévia em projetos de Inteligência Artificial e outras tecnologias emergentes.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) ou frameworks de inovação (Design Thinking).
  • Certificações em Gestão de Projetos (PMP, CSM) ou Gestão de Produtos (CSPO) são um diferencial.
  • Visão de negócio apurada e proatividade para identificar oportunidades e desafios.
  • Capacidade analítica apurada para identificar causas-raiz e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação para definição de requisitos e fluxos/processos.

Competências Supercomm:

  • Espírito Empreendedor: Visão de dono e proatividade para identificar oportunidades e desafios.
  • Atitude Digital: Adaptabilidade a novas tecnologias e processos, com mentalidade de inovação.
  • Velocidade: Habilidade para trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico, com foco em entregas rápidas e eficientes.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade analítica apurada para identificar causas-raiz e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Entendimento do Negócio: Visão estratégica para alinhar projetos de TI aos objetivos da empresa.
  • Colaboração: Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal para trabalhar em equipe.

Additional information

O Que Oferecemos: Seu crescimento conosco

Na Supercomm, investimos em nosso time porque sabemos que o seu sucesso é o nosso sucesso. Oferecemos um ambiente que estimula o Crescimento e a Valorização , com:

  • Pacote de benefícios abrangente: Salário competitivo, SulAmérica Saúde e Dental, Icatu Seguros, Swile (TotalPass) e PLR.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo: Oportunidades de crescimento e plano de desenvolvimento individual (PDI), com treinamentos e capacitações internas alinhados às suas metas.
  • Cultura de inovação: Atue em um ambiente que respira Atitude Digital e Velocidade , com desafios constantes que promovem o seu Espírito Empreendedor .
  • Ambiente colaborativo: Faça parte de um time que pratica o Respeito e a Colaboração , onde suas ideias são valorizadas.
  • Programas exclusivos: Participe dos nossos programas internos como #SuperInfluencers e #SuperIndicações , fortalecendo nossa cultura e o engajamento.

title: AUDITOR ESPECIALISTA I
description:
Job description

Será responsável pela execução de trabalhos em processos de alta complexidade relacionados à TI, Segurança da Informação e Cibersegurança com o objetivo de elaborar relatórios de auditoria de maneira objetiva e independente. Deve também propor recomendações para melhoria do ambiente de controles internos nesses ambientes com soluções que permitam a eliminação ou redução dos riscos de perdas, bem como a proteção de seus ativos. Atender as necessidades de auditoria em todos os locais geográficos, lógicos e organizacionais em que o grupo TecBan ou seus parceiros de negócios atuam.


Main responsibilities

•Realizar entrevistas com pessoas chave para obter entendimento da estrutura de controles, riscos envolvidos e análise prévia do fluxo de atividades da área ou processo, indicando possíveis riscos e apontar eventuais controles não mapeados pela área;

•Elaborar relatórios descrevendo fatos, indicando riscos, causas e realizando recomendação de ações corretivas, visando a melhoria dos controles e do desempenho da área auditada;

•Elaborar e executar testes de auditoria para certificar a adequação e a efetividade dos controles dos processos ou atividades perante os riscos identificados;

•Revisar/apoiar a execução de teste, pontos de auditorias e relatórios preparados por auditores com menor experiência;

•Utilizar metodologia e padrões definidos pela Auditoria Interna aprovados pelo Comitê de Auditoria e indicados pelo IIA (The Institute of Internal Auditors);

•Manter-se atualizado em relação às técnicas, conceitos e métodos de Auditoria adotados, tanto no aspecto metodológico quanto tecnológico, contribuindo para análises dos riscos e embasamento dos apontamentos;

•Apoiar a supervisão no desenvolvimento de material de apoio e apresentações.

•Apresentar os resultados de relatório de auditoria ao Comitê de Auditoria, objetivando reportar os principais apontamentos identificados, bem como, as recomendações e plano de ação das áreas auditadas.

•Manter organizado e arquivado os papéis de trabalho de forma sistemática e racional, com o objetivo de contribuir no processo de programa de qualidade da Auditoria Interna. (Certificação IIA)

•Preencher a documentação de apoio e utilizar a ferramenta de Auditoria em todas as fases do trabalho indicando evidências e coletando os planos de ação indicados para a remediação do processo.

•Realizar follow-up regulamente para verificar junto às áreas auditadas se as recomendações foram implementadas com o objetivo de acompanhar a finalização dos planos de ação criados pelas áreas, mitigando os riscos apontados no relatório de auditoria.


Requirements and skills

Escolaridade

Curso superior completo, desejável, em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia, Administração De Empresas, Contábeis ou Engenharia.

Treinamentos/

Certificações

Desejável CISA, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, CEH, CIA, CCSA ou CRMA.

Conhecimentos

Desejável no mínimo 5 anos de experiência em Auditoria Interna ou Externa, Cibersegurança, Segurança da Informação, Infraestrutura de TI, pentest, hacker ético, Desenvolvimento de Software e LGPD.

Conhecimentos em NIST, CIS, Cobit, ISO 27001, MITRE, COSO, Gerenciamento de Riscos e Controles, Normas Internacionais de Auditoria Interna, Pacote Office e Processos de Negócios.

Desejável Inglês avançado.

Competências

Bom relacionamento interpessoal e boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

Remote position within Argentina & Uruguay
RYZ Labs is seeking a skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our client's team—a pioneering company revolutionizing how micro-business owners transform their crafting passions into thriving businesses. If you thrive on decision-making, enjoy shaping strategies, and love transforming your expertise into actionable outcomes, this role is tailor-made for you.
Basic Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in the e-commerce sector is ideal, with a focus on customer journey analysis, such as checkout processes and customer feedback
  • Familiarity with multiple tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker), including CRM systems and platforms like Shopify, demonstrating versatility in handling diverse technologies
  • Strong SQL experience

About RYZ Labs:
RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world.
Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries,planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years.
At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion, and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.
Our values and what to expect:
  • Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer
  • Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated
  • Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility
  • Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone who interacts with RYZ with respect
  • Frugality - being frugal and cost-conscious helps us do more with less
  • Deliver Impact - get things done in the most efficient way
  • Raise our Standards - always be looking to improve our processes, our team, and our expectations. The status quo is not good enough and never should be

Você será fundamental para garantir a integração eficiente do cronograma, gerenciamento de custos e relatórios precisos, promovendo consistência e eficiência ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto. Se você se vê como parte de uma equipe que ajuda a economia global a crescer por meio da nossa rede mundial de clientes e terminais, adoraríamos que você se candidatasse às nossas vagas!
Estamos atualmente buscando um Especialista em Controle de Cronograma . Nesta função, você desempenhará um papel vital em nosso sucesso. Se você estiver interessado na posição e quiser seguir uma carreira conosco, convidamos você a fazer parte do nosso time!
Quais são as principais responsabilidades desta função?

  • Desenvolver e manter cronogramas abrangentes para projetos, operações ou tarefas, garantindo o alinhamento com objetivos e prazos.
  • Colaborar com diversos departamentos para reunir informações e insumos necessários para fins de agendamento.
  • Analisar regularmente os cronogramas para identificar possíveis conflitos, restrições de recursos ou gargalos, propondo soluções para otimizar a eficiência.

  • Fornecer relatórios e atualizações regulares sobre o desempenho do cronograma aos stakeholders, destacando métricas-chave e áreas para melhoria.
  • Refinar continuamente metodologias e ferramentas de agendamento para aumentar a precisão e a eficácia.
  • Avaliar requisitos de recursos, dados de compromisso e relatórios de produtividade e variação de custo desenvolvidos pela equipe de entrega.
  • Apoiar a implementação da Gestão de Valor Agregado (Earned Value Management) no projeto.
O que estamos procurando?
Qualificações
  • Formação superior em disciplina técnica ou voltada à gestão de projetos é desejável.
  • Certificação em gerenciamento de projetos é preferencial.

Recurrent Energy is a wholly owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and is one of the world's largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and O&M platforms. At Recurrent Energy, we believe in the power of teamwork to create a sustainable future. Join us as we work together toward a cleaner, greener tomorrow.

You will lead the development, coordination and review of designs and technical standards for Recurrent Energy’s utility scale solar and BESS projects. At the core, as a Project Engineer you are an expert coordinator, bringing together stakeholders of every level for effective and profitable project deliveries.

Design Oversight

  • Develop, coordinate development, and review designs for Recurrent Energy projects (including permitting and construction support, customer care, and sales support).

Construction Support

  • Provide engineering and QA/QC support to the project management team during project construction and commissioning.
  • Provide technical direction during startup, testing, PV system commissioning and performance monitoring.
  • Provide technical support for the review/preparation of client proposals and EPC/equipment RFP packages.
  • Participate in the evaluation and selection of EPC and main equipment suppliers.
  • Participate in the preparation, review, and negotiations of the technical exhibits for project sales, equipment procurement and EPC contracting agreements.
  • Attend factory acceptance tests for HV and electrical equipment.
  • Evaluation of PV products, emerging technologies and best practices in the solar EPC field.
  • Collectively responsible for project budgets of $100 – 500 million
  • Communicate and influence cross-functionally within Recurrent Energy.
  • Responsible for consultant scopes and associated costs.

Reporting Relationships & Interactions

  • Works cross functionally and collaboratively with all departments.
  • Manages consultant work orders to ensure scope, schedule, quality and coordination requirements are met.
  • Interfaces with third-party engineering service providers, and subcontractors.

Abilities

  • Problem solving skills: takes a systematic and proactive approach to solving problems. Actively seeks out issues rather than reacting to them as they come up.
  • Self-development: knows own capabilities, seeks out feedback and responds positively to constructive criticism.
  • Critical thinking: can break a situation down into smaller pieces to identify its key or underlying issues.
  • Flexibility: has the ability to work in a variety of situations, and with various individuals and groups. Understanding and appreciating different and opposing perspectives on an issue and adapting one’s approach to the changes at hand.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual will perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in an Engineering or Technical field.
  • 3-5 years of progressive experience with engineering. procurement and construction of utility scale solar PV systems.
  • Extensive knowledge of IEEE and other governing standards for design of solar PV systems.
  • Knowledge of solar and BESS project engineering, procurement, and construction processes.
  • Knowledge of engineering economics and design optimization.
  • Knowledge of project contract terms including PPAs, interconnection agreements and real estate.

  • Working knowledge of basic computer skills.
  • Travel to project sites when needed.
  • Bilingual with Portuguese and English.

At Recurrent Energy, we are committed to fostering career growth and development. As a Project Engineer, you will be an individual contributor who must manage complex schedules and meet deadlines, navigate a variety of personalities, and stay on (or under) budgets. Your manager will help you advance your career in a way that suits your goals and strengths.

The Backend Team at Wildlife is reinventing itself. It started providing services for the games' online features and has since evolved to provide a platform that leverages the best of our teams when creating, operating and distributing our games.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and to achieve that, we work with a broad technology stack and have an approach of being fully responsible for our systems, from their conception to incident resolution and troubleshooting in production.

We own several services that, combined, serve more than 1 million requests per minute. We know this number will only grow, and we're looking for engineers that can help with the challenges of developing backend systems that perform well at a large scale.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent tech areas and/or equivalent experience.
  • Solid experience in software development and solution design.
  • Solid understanding of computer concepts (data structures, networking, concurrency, memory management, and algorithm analysis).
  • Excellent knowledge of software testing concepts (testability, escape rate, regression, unit, integration, soak, stress, test automation).

Nice to have

  • Experience developing and maintaining systems with a high volume of requests.
  • Experience developing systems in the games industry.
  • Experience developing systems in the ad tech ecosystem.
  • Experience developing platform products.
  • Business knowledge about the games industry.
  • Experience in Golang.
  • Experience in Unity development.

Description
Esta é uma vaga que tem o intuito de coletar talentos para posições futuras e é uma posição de contribuidor individual.
A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho, e por isso atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos. No Brasil , estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de áreas e cargos diferentes pois entendemos que essa agenda precisa de diferentes perspectivas e vivências múltiplas. Nossa liderança é engajada e entende cada dia mais o seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos príncipios de liderança, com objetivo de sermos “a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo”. Sabemos da nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança e somos conscientes de que “ Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades”. Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de DEI. Além disso, atuam como embaixadores dessa agenda e vão te apoiar desde o Day 1. Lembre-se “ it´s always Day 1”. Os grupos estão organizados nas seguintes frentes: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e Pessoa com Deficiência.
Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) é um serviço que visa ajudar marcas e parceiros estratégicos a se desenvolverem de maneira sustentável com a Amazon. AVS ajuda os paceiros na Amazon a crescer de maneira sustentável, além de aumentar a disponibilidade e a descoberta de seus produtos. A Equipe de Especialistas Supply Chain é especializada em ajudar parceiros com desafios operacionais a alinhar melhor seus processos logísticos com a Amazon, analisar problemas de cadeia de suprimentos e desenvolver soluções sustentáveis para evitar perdas financeiras e trazer a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.Nesta posição, você reportará ao líder de gestão de operações de categoria e trabalhará para construir a estratégia de Supply Chain de contas chave. Você será responsável por liderar o planejamento de previsão de estoque, execução de compras e melhoria operacional de projetos, atuando como ponto de contato chave para gestão de estoque para um segmento de fornecedores. Você irá trabalhar na identificação de oportunidades de simplificar e automatizar tarefas, garantindo que sistemas e processos de inventário atendem às necessidades do negócio, implementando controles sobre estes. A pessoa ideal terá energia para lidar com ambiente em que atividades táticas e estratégicas acontecerão paralelamente.
Nesta posição, você irá gerenciar fornecedores de alta complexidade, trabalhando com autonomia para entregar o serviço. Você também será responsável por projetos de médio a alto impacto, atingindo especialistas de Supply Chain AVS em várias categorias de produtos e implementando melhorias de processos escaláveis para todo o varejo da Amazon.
Key job responsibilities

  • Análise da operação de supply chain utilizando dados e identificando as causas dos problemas operacionais (giro de estoque, lead time, reabastecimento, taxa de confirmação, forecast);
  • Definição de planos de ação conjunta com os parceiros para eliminar defeitos de Supply Chain e fazer revisões regulares de progresso com fornecedores para criar resultados sustentáveis de longo prazo;
  • Cooperar e construir um relacionamento de confiança em todas as funções e níveis de trabalho dentro da organização do parceiro (por exemplo, gerente de contas chave, gerente de Supply Chain, gerente de atendimento ao cliente), bem como na Amazon (Vendor Managers - gerentes comerciais, especialistas de contas chave, InStock Managers - gerentes de Supply Chain, gerentes de produto/programa, Equipes de Operações);
  • Preparação de revisões regulares de progresso para implementar soluções sustentáveis e resultados de longo prazo;
  • Organização e gestão de projetos com fornecedores sobre melhoria contínua/Kaizens;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos internos para desenvolver ainda mais o programa AVS (por exemplo, planejamento de recursos, comunicação interna e externa, criação de mecanismos para soluções de problemas de toda a população de fornecedores, automação de relatórios etc.)
Basic Qualifications
  • Bacharel/Licenciatura (engenharia, administração ou áreas relacionadas à operações/cadeia de suprimento/logística);
  • Forte habilidade analítica, afinidade com números e habilidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Alto nível de auto-organização, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de produto/categoria, logística, gestão da cadeia e/ou de suprimentos;
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal em inglês avançada;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de público sênior e influência de pessoas.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experiência com SQL;
  • Experiência com painéis de dados (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, QlikSense);
  • Experiência com Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen;
  • Experiência com gerencimento de pessoas;
  • Experiência com análise financeira/qualitativa

description:

Customs and Border Protection Officer - Entry Level

Join to apply for the Customs and Border Protection Officer - Entry Level role at U.S. Customs and Border Protection

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

U.S. Customs and Border Protection provided pay range

This range is provided by U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$40,332.00/yr - $109,952.00/yr

Customs and Border Protection Officer (CBPO)
U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) offers those interested in a career in law enforcement an exceptional opportunity to work with an elite team of highly trained professionals whose camaraderie, pride, and purpose are hallmarks of their daily mission of protecting America. You will be part of the Department of Homeland Security workforce, protecting American interests and securing our nation.
If you are looking for a rewarding career with great pay, benefits, and job stability, now is the time to make your move.
As a Customs and Border Protection Officer (CBPO) , you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation’s economic prosperity. Being a CBPO makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.
Typical Assignments Include

  • Enforcing customs, immigration, and agriculture laws and regulations.
  • Facilitating the flow of legitimate trade and travel.
  • Conducting inspections of individuals and conveyances.
  • Determining the admissibility of individuals for entry into the United States.
  • Preventing the illegal entry of individuals and prohibited goods and the smuggling of illegal drugs and other contraband.
Duty Locations – Incentives available for some locations
You will be asked to provide your preference for one of the following mission-critical locations: Nogales, and San Luis, AZ; Calexico, Los Angeles, Otay Mesa, San Francisco, San Ysidro, and Tecate, CA; Washington, DC; Miami and Orlando, FL; Atlanta, GA; Hagatna, Guam; Honolulu, HI; Chicago, IL; Calais, Fort Kent, Houlton, Jackman, Madawaska, Van Buren, and Vanceboro, ME; Detroit and Port Huron, MI; Baudette, Grand Portage, International Falls, and Warroad, MN; Del Bonita, Morgan, Raymond, Roosville, and Wild Horse, MT; Newark, NJ; Alexandria Bay, Buffalo, Champlain, Massena, Ogdensburg, Queens, and Trout River, NY; Dunseith, Hansboro, Neche, Pembina, and Portal, ND; Philadelphia, PA; San Juan, PR; El Paso and Houston, TX; Christiansted, U.S. Virgin Islands; Beecher Falls, Derby Line, Highgate Springs, Norton, and Richford, VT; Blaine Oroville, Seattle and Sumas, WA.
The preference locations listed above are expected to have vacancies available in the future, however, if the duty locations do not have vacancies at the time of your final offer, you may be offered a duty location in another geographic location within the United States. Locations offered are based on operational and mission requirements and critical agency hiring needs for entry-level CBPOs as determined by the CBP Office of Field Operations (OFO).
Salary – and Duty Location Recruitment Incentives – and Benefits
Annual Base Salary for newly appointed CBPOs varies as follows:
  • GS-5 and GS-7 $40,332- $109,952 per year
Locality pay varies by duty location.
Note: A fully trained CBPO is eligible for up to $45,000 in overtime pay in addition to the starting salary.
Grade level eligibility and salaries vary depending upon background, including experience and education, and duty location of the opportunity. This is a career ladder position with a grade level progression of GS-5, GS-7, GS-9, GS-11, and GS-12. You will be eligible for a promotion to the next higher grade level (without re-applying) once you successfully complete 52 weeks in each grade level. Promotions are at the discretion of the agency.
Officers are eligible to select from an array of federal employment benefits that include health, dental and other insurance plans, a generous annual and sick leave program, and participation in the Thrift Savings Plan, a retirement plan akin to a traditional and ROTH 401(k) offering.
LOCATION INCENTIVES: If you accept one of the duty locations listed below, you may be eligible to receive an additional 15%-25% of your salary each year for the first three (3) years of employment in addition to any overtime pay. If you accept the duty location of San Francisco, you may be eligible to receive an additional 25% of your salary each year for the first four (4) years of employment in addition to any overtime pay. These incentives only apply to new federal employees and are dependent upon the availability of funds.
Duty locations offering 25% recruitment incentives: Otay Mesa, San Francisco, San Ysidro, and Tecate, CA; Key West, FL; Calais and Jackman, ME; Detroit, MI; Grand Portage, MN; Raymond and Sweetgrass, MT; Dunseith and Pembina, ND; Beecher Falls, VT; Oroville, WA
Duty locations offering 15% recruitment incentives: Honolulu, HI; Portal, ND; Derby Line and Richford, VT; Blaine, WA
Duty location offering 10% recruitment incentives: Calexico, CA
Qualifications
You qualify for the GS-5 grade level if you possess one of the following:
Experience: A minimum of three (3) years full-time general work experience that demonstrates the ability to meet and deal with people and the ability to learn and be able to apply a body of facts;OR
Education Substitution: A bachelor's degree or successful completion of a full four (4)-year course of study in any field leading to a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university;OR
Combination of Experience and Education: A combination of successfully completed college educationANDgeneral work experience. This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial college transcripts submitted with your application.
You qualify for the GS-7 grade level if you possess one of the following:
Experience: A minimum of one (1) year of specialized full-time work experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level that includes:
  • Performing physical inspections of people, documents or goods for criminal activity, fraud, and/or illegal operations.
  • Utilizing observational techniques, evaluating facts, and reviewing documentation while applying Federal, State, or local laws and regulations.
  • Making determinations in compliance with laws and regulations that may lead to arrests, seizure of property, fines, and/or penalties based on findings.
OR For The GS-7 Grade Level
Education Substitution: A bachelor's degree with Superior Academic Achievement based on (1) class standing, (2) grade-point average (3.0 or higher), or (3) honor society membership;OR one (1) full year of graduate-level education. This education must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work;OR
Combination of Experience and Education: A combination of specialized work experience equivalent to the next lower grade levelANDgraduate level education from an accredited college or university. This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.
If you have previous or current law enforcement or military law enforcement experience , you may qualify at the GS-9 grade level. See the GS-9 Job Opportunity Announcement (JOAs) at USAJOBS, the federal government’s official employment site to determine if you qualify.
Other Requirements
Citizenship: You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this position.
Residency: You must have had primary U.S. residency (includes protectorates as declared under international law) for at least three (3) of the last five (5) years.
Age Restriction: In accordance with Public Law 100-238, this position is covered under law enforcement retirement provisions. Candidates must be referred for selection to the Customs and Border Protection Officer position before reaching their 40th birthday in accordance with Department of Homeland Security Directive 251-03. The age restriction may not apply if you are currently serving or have previously served in a federal civilian law enforcement (non-military) position covered by Title 5 U.S.C. 8336(c) or Title 5 U.S.C. 8412(d).
Veterans’ Preference: You may also be eligible for an excepted service Veterans Recruitment Appointment (VRA). The age restriction does not apply if you are Veterans' Preference eligible.
Formal Training: You will be required to complete a paid pre-academy orientation for approximately two (2) weeks at your home port. You will then attend a 101-day training program – CBP Field Operations Academy – conducted at theFederal Law Enforcement Training Center (FLETC)located in Glynco, GA. This training consists of basic law enforcement skills, immigration laws, firearms training, examination of cargo/bags/merchandise, physical fitness, etc. Candidates assigned to the southern border, Miami, or Puerto Rico duty locations must attend and pass an online Spanish training program, which will be completed at their home port. Successful completion of the Academy is required for this position.
How To Apply
Click the Apply button on this site. You will be linked to the CBP Talent Network page. For Position of Interest , select Customs and Border Protection Officer.
You’ll then receive a link(s) to the CBPO JOA(s) on USAJOBS to complete your application. Be certain to review ALL details of the job opportunity announcement and follow all instructions in the application process, including items (resume, transcripts, etc.) to submit. You will be evaluated based on your resume, supporting documents, and the CBPO Entrance Exam.
As a subscriber to the CBP Talent Network, you’ll receive monthly emails with information about webinars, career expos, and future opportunities with OFO and CBP.

description:
Job description

Fiscalizar e realizar o cumprimento dos padrões operacionais e de segurança que possuam o objetivo de inibição e redução das perdas da loja. Prevenir a ocorrência de pequenos furtos e desvios de mercadoria, zelar pela segurança física e patrimonial de colaboradores e clientes dentro da loja.


Main responsibilities

• Receber mercadoria, atuar no setor de recebimento de mercadorias, organizar o fluxo de entrada dos veículos de carga na loja, autorizar a entrada, acompanhar o descarregamento e a movimentação do motorista no interior do setor, autorizar a saída, fechar e abrir portões da loja;

• Estocar produtos, acompanhar os serviços de estocagem dos produtos recebidos, verificar se não há desvios de mercadorias, checar se não há movimentações estranhas no estoque;

• Repor, acompanhar a reposição de produtos na loja, com o intuito de evitar desvios e avarias nos produtos;

• Acompanhar a comercialização de produtos confinados, contar cigarros e bebidas (de alto valor), anotar as quantidades e solicitar sua reposição;

• Fazer a retirada e entrega do produto para o cliente, conforme a solicitação;

• Efetuar contagem e monitoramento de carrinhos com o intuito de evitar seus roubos;

• Monitorar as operações de modo a evitar furtos e desvios dentro da loja;

• Verificar autorizações, identificar e encaminhar visitantes ao departamento ou local desejado, registrando entrada e dados do visitante na falta de memorandos;

• Armazenar e organizar os pertences pessoais dos funcionários, tais como bolsas, roupas etc;

• Etiquetar todos os produtos comprados na loja pelos funcionários para consumo interno;

• Acompanhar movimentações na área de trabalho, observando acessos de pessoas em áreas restritas, restringindo o consumo de cigarros em áreas determinadas e observando possíveis furtos;

• Observar o estacionamento verificando os carros estacionados fora da área demarcada e comunicando ao departamento responsável para que o motorista seja chamado no alto-falante;

• Prevenir e evitar furtos, desentendimento entre clientes, algazarra e demais comportamentos inadequados;

• Monitorar os movimentos dos caixas, evitando e prevenindo possíveis crimes, atentando-se a clientes suspeitos e atitudes suspeitas das pessoas;


Requirements and skills

  • Necessário Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Será considerado um diferencial ter atuado na área de prevenção de Perdas e Fiscalização;
  • Será considerado um diferencial ter atuado no ramo alimentício - Atacadista, Hipermercados, Supermercados, Açougue etc.

Additional information

Local de trabalho: 100% presencial

Benefícios:

  • Refeitório no local
  • Cartão Multibeneficios
  • Vale-Transporte

  • Assistência odontológica

Sobre o Time:

O time Fiscal é responsável por assegurar a conformidade tributária da empresa, atuando de forma estratégica na apuração e no cumprimento das obrigações acessórias, além de identificar oportunidades de eficiência fiscal. Buscamos entregar informações fiscais precisas, atualizadas e alinhadas com a legislação vigente, contribuindo diretamente para a sustentabilidade financeira e o crescimento saudável do negócio. Além disso, atuamos como suporte técnico para outras áreas, esclarecendo dúvidas fiscais e promovendo a melhoria contínua dos processos.


Main responsibilities

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Experiência na área fiscal, com conhecimento prático de tributos diretos e indiretos, preferencialmente em empresas do lucro real e presumido.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipal.
  • Domínio de obrigações acessórias (SPEDs, DCTF, GIA etc.) e boas práticas de compliance fiscal.
  • Vivência com sistemas ERP (desejável: UAU);
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade para interpretar normas, tomar decisões e mitigar riscos fiscais.
  • Habilidade de liderar e influenciar equipes, com foco em melhoria de performance e desenvolvimento técnico.

Critérios que aumentam o match com a vaga:

  • Pós-graduação em áreas como Tributário , Controladoria ou Planejamento Fiscal .
  • Experiência com projetos de automatização fiscal , RPA ou uso de Power BI .
  • Atuação prévia em empresas do segmento imobiliário .

CONTEXTO / DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em Fortaleza, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.
